name: roobook
description: Search the RooBook library of the account you connect. Results include page numbers, EPUB links, image coordinates, and roobook:// links you can open in the Mac or iOS app. You can also save a private reading note on a book or a page. Sign-in happens on RooBook. This plugin does not ask for your RooBook password. Remove the plugin in Grok Bot to stop new calls. Access is limited to that one account.
